active.description: false when the item is blocked or retired in the ERP

base_unit_of_measure.description: the unit every quantity and price on this record is per

book_cost.description: the unit cost the stock on hand is carried at

costing_method.description: how the ERP values the item's stock

currency.description: the currency of every amount on this record (`standard_cost`, `book_cost`, `last_direct_cost`, `sell_price`), an ISO 4217 alpha-3 code. A record with no currency has no usable amount.

description.description: the item as the ERP describes it

index_series_key.description: the platform_rate series that ages this item's last purchase price

item_no.description: the item's number in the ERP; the same key as `purchase_line.item_reference`

last_direct_cost.description: the unit cost of the item's most recent purchase, as the ERP records it

sell_price.description: the unit price the contractor charges when it supplies the item

standard_cost.description: the standard unit cost, when `costing_method` is `standard`

target_margin_pct.description: the margin on the sell price the contractor targets, 0 to 100. No default: absent means the target is not set.

tax_basis.description: whether the amounts on this record include GST or VAT
